amplitude_normalization.application_rule: Apply this same multiplicative scale unchanged to every redshift, survey stratum, SBMAG node, realization ID, and both SDSS and DES branches.
amplitude_normalization.definition: Compute the synthetic Hsiao flux proxy through the frozen SDSS-r response over the frozen Hsiao phase interval at z=0.15. Let P be its maximum. The single global scale is A=1000/P.
forbidden: matching amplitudes to observed Stage 1 or Stage 2 data
amplitude_normalization.interpretation: This is an explicit common numerical normalization convention, not an absolute-luminosity or cosmological standard-candle model.

peak_epoch_rule.authorization_requirement: The deterministic/stochastic mapping from Stage 3C realization ID to one candidate peak anchor must be frozen before production_authorized may become true.
peak_epoch_rule.definition: Candidate true peak epochs are constructed only inside valid within-season cadence gaps no longer than 30 days, at fixed fractions 0.25, 0.50, and 0.75 of each eligible gap.

realization_to_anchor_mapping.candidate_ordering: Sort eligible within-season cadence gaps chronologically; within each gap order anchors by fraction 0.25, 0.50, 0.75.
realization_to_anchor_mapping.candidate_selection: For N eligible candidate anchors and latent quantile u, select index=min(floor(u*N), N-1). Each survey maps the common latent quantile onto its own ordered candidate-anchor list.
realization_to_anchor_mapping.interpretation: The latent peak-placement nuisance is paired across surveys; absolute peak MJD differs according to each survey's cadence geometry.
realization_to_anchor_mapping.pairing_rule: For each (z, realization_id), generate one deterministic U[0,1) latent peak-placement quantile. Reuse exactly the same quantile for SDSS and DES and for every SBMAG node.
realization_to_anchor_mapping.seed_key: SHA256(namespace|purpose|z|realization_id), first 8 digest bytes interpreted as unsigned 64-bit integer

peak_epoch_rule.source: Pre-existing cadence-template injection mechanics; not chosen using downstream Stage 1/2 outcomes.
peak_epoch_rule.template_peak_definition: Continuous Hsiao template peak determined from the dense synthetic template light curve.

purpose: Final pre-production parameter freeze for the Stage 3C physics-only paired SDSS/DES forward-model experiment.
remaining_blocker: Perform final hash/provenance verification of the fully frozen production specification, then execute the explicit production-authorization gate.
